name: Spinach Chickpea Curry with Basmati Rice

components.name: Spinach Chickpea Curry
steps: Heat oil in a broad saucepan and soften onion; add garlic and ginger for the last minute.
Add tomatoes and curry spices and simmer until tomatoes collapse.
Stir in chickpeas, light coconut milk and water; simmer covered for 12-15 minutes.
Add spinach in handfuls and cook just until wilted; season with salt.
Divide rice and curry evenly into four meals; leave some moisture for reheating.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: Cook washed dry rice with measured water and set aside to rest covered.
